notes.title: The v0.72 update requires DLC.
notes.content: The v0.72 update requires DLC. It adds a large map system and a new CG. I’ll try to maintain a higher update frequency going forward, sorry for being busy earlier.

notes.content:
v0.3 version update.

2.Optimized the UI of the start screen.
3.Added a tutorial to the main menu.
4.Added level 9.
5.The pigsty can now enable automatic harvesting.】[v0.3バージョンの更新。
If you find that the mod is not working, please update to the new version of the mod!
